props.caption: The index records an electronics upgrade while conditional subsidies stay outside the collected price.

items.note: Civilian airport management changed hands while the military facility entered a three-month conversion without published operating terms.
Tablets rose 11.3% in the monthly index while three electronics products added only 0.03 point to CPI.
AI2379 lost roughly 300 feet during cruise; the initial pilot screen still requires laboratory confirmation.
Pakistan called the pact defensive while the Israeli objection in public came from an analyst outside government.
Demi Vollering won the final stage and the Tour de France Femmes by 1 minute 18 seconds.

items.kicker: Pakistan Defines the Pact; Israel Stays Off Paper
items.what: Pakistan’s foreign minister called the Makkah pact defensive and open to peaceful future accessions. Israeli concern in the 9 August public record came from INSS analyst Yoel Guzansky, while the PMO, foreign ministry and defence ministry published no response. No new signatory or operating text appeared.

items.kicker: A Pilot Screen Waits for the Laboratory
items.what: India classified Air India flight AI2379’s roughly 300-foot cruise-altitude loss as a Serious Incident. The captain’s initial screen requires confirmatory analysis; both pilots are off roster while investigators await the laboratory result and examine the flight itself.

items.kicker: Subscription Exit Gets a January Date
items.what: Britain says easier subscription cancellation will begin in January 2027 through secondary legislation. Fake discounts and misleading reference prices remain headed for an autumn consultation, while the CMA’s existing direct-enforcement powers already carry fines up to 10% of global turnover.

items.kicker: Iran Moves Rezaei Into the Security Chair
items.what: Iran’s leader made Mohsen Rezaei his representative on the Supreme National Security Council, and the president appointed Rezaei council secretary. Mohammad Bagher Zolghadr moved to political adviser. The decrees establish the personnel change; any policy turn remains to be demonstrated.

Irish authorities took custody of Daniel Kinahan in Dubai, flew him to Ireland and charged him with directing a criminal organisation. The transfer is the material event; prosecutors still have to prove the charge, and the legal undertaking that unlocked extradition remains the next document to obtain.

items.kicker: Bulgaria Finds a Drone After Radar Did Not
items.what: Preliminary wreckage analysis identified the aircraft near Kardam as most likely a Maya decoy. No one was injured and infrastructure was undamaged about one kilometre from a Trans-Balkan compressor station. Bulgaria’s defence chief offered electronic-warfare diversion as a supposition, not a forensic finding.

items.kicker: Vollering Wins the Stage and the Tour
items.what: Demi Vollering attacked on the final Col d’Èze ascent, won Stage 9 in Nice and secured her second Tour de France Femmes title by 1 minute 18 seconds. A crash changed the lower podium; the yellow jersey had already been settled by the climb.

items.kicker: Hawaii’s Saturday Ballots Arrive on Sunday UTC
items.what: Representative Ed Case defeated a left-wing primary challenger after Hawaii’s 19:00 Saturday deadline became 05:00 Sunday in UTC. Election-night totals establish the winner call while cured ballots can still alter the eventual certified count.

Israel’s prime minister publicly rejected the Trump administration’s Gaza proposal, turning a negotiating framework into an acknowledged policy split. The unresolved work is identifying which provisions must change and whether Washington will apply leverage to preserve the plan.

Iran says its Oman-brokered Strait arrangement is in final stages while tying commercial reopening to changes in United States policy. No matching operational text, effective date or usable route description appeared, leaving the existing reopening call open at p(NO)=0.28.
